fields.summary_ko.0: Visa (V) provided low double-digit adjusted net income growth guidance for fiscal 2027, with management expecting fiscal Q2 2027 as the low point for 2027 growth.
fields.summary_ko.1: Approximately 25% of Visa volume will be up for renewal in fiscal 2027, up from 20% in 2026 and including many large customers; value-added services revenue expected to moderate from 30% growth in 2026 to low-to-mid 20% growth in 2027.
